parsed.explanation: No current trans-specific offence, facility ban, border or custody rule is documented, and post-2004 evidence shows state-backed acceptance: constitutional SOGI protection (2019), gender-change recognition (2022, a climate signal), a state trans-rights programme working with police/courts, growing pride marches and a trans elected official. Against this, 2001/2004 police campaigns arrested and sanctioned travestis for presentation (up to 4 years) - dated, so weak evidence of current practice - and current police posture, bathroom access, border document practice and trans violence are undocumented, not proven safe. Rights are described as contested/not uniformly enforced, with post-2021 political crackdown and activist monitoring, so paper protections lack a documented visitor-facing remedy operating in practice. This places it in reduced-risk territory below jurisdictions with demonstrated enforcement, with uncertainty holding it below 0.75.
